summary: Plaud Recordings to Google Calendar Events: Puts the meetings you agree to out loud straight onto your Google Calendar, without Zapier in the middle. Plaud's own app has no Calendar integration, so this closes that gap directly: each new recording is scanned, the transcript pulled, and any genuine scheduling commitment spoken in it ("let's do Tuesday at 3", "I'll come back out Thursday morning") is extracted with the relative date resolved against the recording's own date and your timezone. Eac.
